name: argos
description: An offensive security research framework, MCP server, and agent plugin for Codex, OpenCode, and Claude Code.

interface.shortDescription: Build and query a connected offensive security knowledge map.
interface.longDescription: Argos is an offensive security research framework for Codex, OpenCode, and Claude Code. Its MCP server and agent skills keep one canonical Markdown note per target item, link components, sinks, flows, authority, state, tests, and conclusions, retrieve bounded subgraphs, suggest missing relations for review, and export the map to Obsidian.
defaultPrompt: Initialize an Argos knowledge map for this target.
Recover the relevant subgraph before continuing this research.
Find untested relations and plausible sink chains in the current map.
